title.rendered: E-Waste Processing – TOMRA Autosort Optical Sorter Finder Mode

content.rendered:
TOMRA Autosort optical sorter separating e-scrap using finder mode.

For electronic waste and e-scrap processing, the TOMRA Autosort optical sorter’s Finder Mode uses sensors and air ejection technology to separate metals from non-metals, and give you cleaner fractions. See it at Van Dyk Recycling Solutions’s Norwalk, CT Test Center. Schedule your own test at https://vdrs.com/test-your-recycling-material/
